title: Senior Executive - Logistics
description:
Job Description Job Title: Senior Executive Logistics
 Location: Khopoli
 Reports to: Asst. Manager/ Manager Logistics Key Responsibilities Logistics Operations & Dispatch Coordinate day-to-day logistics and dispatch operations at the Khopoli site. Coordinate with transporters for timely vehicle placement as per dispatch plan. Monitor loading, vehicle reporting, dispatch and documentation activities to ensure smooth operations. Track daily dispatch plan vs. actual dispatch and highlight gaps/escalations. Ensure adherence to defined loading, dispatch, safety and compliance procedures. Coordinate with warehouse and dispatch teams to ensure optimum vehicle turnaround time. Transporter Coordination: Coordinate with transporters for vehicle placement, availability and dispatch requirements. Follow up on pending vehicle placements and ensure adherence to agreed timelines. Maintain regular communication with transporters regarding operational issues and service gaps. Support transporter performance reviews by providing relevant operational data and analysis. Escalate recurring issues related to vehicle placement, delays, documentation and service performance. Performance & Reporting: Prepare and maintain daily/weekly logistics MIS and operational reports. Track key logistics KPIs such as: OTIF / On-time Dispatch Plan vs. Dispatch Vehicle Placement Adherence Vehicle Turnaround Time Cost per MT / Freight Cost Transit Delays Transit Damage Analyze operational data and highlight deviations, trends and areas requiring attention. Support preparation of management dashboards and presentations. Maintain accurate logistics databases and ensure timely reporting Desirable (not mandatory): Exposure to planning and inventory optimization concepts. Understanding of Planning/ Forecasting Qualifications & Skills Education: Graduate B.Com / B.Sc. / BBA or equivalent. Certification/Diploma in Supply Chain or Logistics will be an advantage. Technical Skills Good working knowledge of MS Excel Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, basic data analysis and reporting. Strong capability in preparing and maintaining MIS and operational dashboards. Good working knowledge of MS PowerPoint and MS Word. Exposure to Power BI / other reporting tools will be an advantage. Experience with SAP/ERP systems for logistics/dispatch transactions will be preferred. Behavioral & Functional Skills Good communication and coordination skills. Strong follow-up and execution capability. Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage day-to-day operational priorities. Data-oriented approach with good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced plant/logistics environment. Strong ownership and accountability for assigned activities. Experience 3–5 years of experience in Logistics / Transportation / Dispatch operations. Experience with a transportation company, manufacturing plant, FMCG, chemicals or other high-volume industry will be preferred. Hands-on experience in vehicle placement, dispatch coordination and transporter management.

Key Skills: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP,Pivot Tables,MS Excel,SUMIFS,VLOOKUP,Microsoft,Senior,Excel
